# Wilsify AI — Database Migrations

**Date**: June 16, 2026  
**Phase**: 6 — Beta Blockers  
**Status**: COMPLETE

---

## Summary

The Prisma migration history has been created from scratch. No previous migration directory existed; all tables were defined directly against a live database without migration files.

---

## Migration Files Created

### `backend/prisma/migrations/migration_lock.toml`

```toml
# Please do not edit this file manually
# It should be added in your version-control system (i.e. Git)
provider = "postgresql"
```

### `backend/prisma/migrations/20260616000001_init/migration.sql`

Full initial schema migration covering all 11 tables:

| Table | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `users` | Core user record including `pushToken String?` |
| `refresh_tokens` | JWT refresh token store (hashed) |
| `password_resets` | Password reset token store (hashed, single-use) |
| `songs` | User-uploaded songs and YouTube sources |
| `analyses` | Analysis results per song (1:1) |
| `chords` | Detected chord events within an analysis |
| `community_posts` | Community feed posts |
| `post_likes` | Many-to-many likes with unique constraint |
| `credit_ledger` | Credits debit/credit history per user |
| `subscriptions` | Active subscription records (one per user) |
| `notifications` | In-app and push notification records |

Enums created: `Plan`, `JobStatus`, `UserRole`.

### `backend/prisma/migrations/20260616000002_add_push_token/migration.sql`

```sql
ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN "pushToken" TEXT;
```

This migration documents the addition of `pushToken` as a separate incremental change for clean audit trail.

---

## pushToken Field

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Model | `User` |
| Field | `pushToken String?` |
| Table | `users` |
| Column | `"pushToken" TEXT` (nullable) |
| Migration | `20260616000002_add_push_token` |
| Validation | Must start with `ExponentPushToken[` (enforced in backend route) |

---

## Deploy Instructions

### Development (first time)
```bash
cd backend
npx prisma migrate dev
```

### Production
```bash
cd backend
npx prisma migrate deploy
```

> `migrate deploy` applies all pending migrations without prompting. Safe for CI/CD pipelines.

### Verify
```bash
npx prisma studio          # visual table browser
npx prisma db pull         # confirm schema matches DB
```

---

## Clean Database Test

To verify the migration works against a clean PostgreSQL instance:

```bash
# Spin up a fresh Postgres container
docker run -d --name wilsify-test-db \
  -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test \
  -e POSTGRES_DB=wilsify_test \
  -p 5433:5432 postgres:16

# Apply migrations
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:test@localhost:5433/wilsify_test \
  npx prisma migrate deploy

# Validate schema
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:test@localhost:5433/wilsify_test \
  npx prisma db pull --print
```

---

## Indexes Created

| Table | Index | Type |
|-------|-------|------|
| users | email | UNIQUE |
| refresh_tokens | tokenHash | UNIQUE |
| songs | userId | BTREE |
| songs | createdAt DESC | BTREE |
| analyses | songId | UNIQUE |
| community_posts | createdAt DESC | BTREE |
| community_posts | likesCount DESC | BTREE |
| post_likes | (userId, postId) | UNIQUE |
| subscriptions | userId | UNIQUE |
| subscriptions | providerId | UNIQUE |
| notifications | userId | BTREE |
| notifications | (read) | BTREE |
| notifications | createdAt DESC | BTREE |
| **songs** | **(userId, status)** | **BTREE (composite)** |
| **subscriptions** | **(userId, status)** | **BTREE (composite)** |
| **notifications** | **(userId, read)** | **BTREE (composite)** |
| **notifications** | **(userId, createdAt DESC)** | **BTREE (composite)** |

Composite indexes added in migration `20260626000004_add_composite_indexes` to eliminate full-table scans on the common `WHERE userId = ? AND status = ?` / `WHERE userId = ? AND read = false ORDER BY createdAt DESC` patterns in the dashboard and notification endpoints.
